title: From
text: Accept input from Goto block, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Icon Display} sets Text to display on block icon Tag; {Goto Tag} sets the tag of the Goto block that forwards its signal to this block, {Update Tags} sets the update list of visible and {Goto Source} sets the path to connected Goto block. Values come from the instance.
